convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators with simple crossover logic. Fixed/percentage position sizing. Standard trailing stop. Trade.mqh includes are standard MT5 library wrappers, not custom logic. No iCustom, no multi-timeframe, no hedging, no grid.

other_exits: Trailing stop only moves SL in profit direction (buy: nsl >= open price, sell: nsl <= open price). Respects broker StopsLevel minimum distance.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots > 0: fixed lot size. If Lots == 0: fraction of free margin (FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000). DecreaseFactor > 0: lot reduced after consecutive losses (lots = lots - lots * losses / DecreaseFactor).

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires all three conditions AND-combined: (1) Fast MA crosses Middle MA, (2) Fast MA is fully above Slow MA on both current and previous bar, (3) Middle MA is fully above Slow MA on both current and previous bar. Opposite for sell. The cross check uses bar[1] vs bar[0] (previous vs current completed bar). The MA shift parameter (6) shifts the MA curve, not the signal bar index. Deviation is set dynamically as Spread*3. Long entry checks OpBuy && !OpSell; Short entry checks OpSell && !OpBuy.
python_conversion_notes: Three SMA indicators with standard params. Entry is AND of crossover + two above/below filters using previous and current bar values. Trailing stop is simple pip-based with StopsLevel respect. Position sizing has conditional branch (fixed vs risk-based vs decrease-after-loss). No digit adjustment needed - SL/TP in _Point units directly. The MA shift parameter creates a visual offset but is handled by the indicator handle - in Python, apply rolling shift after SMA calculation. Consecutive loss counting requires deal history access.
